name: Health Care Services Review
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/HCR) — the 278 RESPONSE's own decision segment. HCR01 (Action Code — e.g. "A1"=Certified in total, "A3"=Certified partial, "A4"=Denied) is the real prior-authorization outcome; HCR02 carries the payer's own certification/authorization number. Only appears on the response side of this engine's single unified 278.json schema — its presence is how the derive script distinguishes a response from a request (see the 278-to-FHIR OOB template's own derive script).
